title: Tech news today, 22 November 2026

items.headline: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
items.summary: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: Microsoft warns it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service.
The attackers gained unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information.
For IT teams, exposure of administrator contact details and tenant configuration data is relevant to how they assess their Entra environments.

items.headline: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets
items.summary: Rackspace warned customers that hackers breached its Rackspace Spot cloud platform using compromised credentials, allowing them to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: Rackspace warned customers that hackers breached its Rackspace Spot cloud platform using compromised credentials.
The attackers could deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters.
IT teams that use Rackspace Spot may need to review credentials and Kubernetes secrets tied to their clusters.

lines: Reported by The Hacker News: Security firm pwn.ai showed that a now-patched Ghostscript flaw lets a crafted file escape the program's security sandbox and run commands on the server that processes it.
Ghostscript is the interpreter many Linux servers use to convert uploaded PDFs, PostScript files, and images into other formats, often without the application calling it directly.
For IT teams, servers that handle file uploads may run Ghostscript even when no application calls it directly, so confirming that installed versions include the patch is relevant.

items.headline: Cleverbridge warns hackers stole credit card numbers, CVVs in data breach
items.summary: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge is warning that hackers breached its systems and stole customers' payment card information, including credit card numbers and CVV security codes. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge is warning that hackers breached its systems and stole customers' payment card information.
The stolen data includes credit card numbers and CVV security codes.
IT teams and business users who buy through Cleverbridge-powered storefronts should review card activity and monitor for suspicious charges.
